question: Will Chelsea FC win on 2026-10-24?
resolution_criteria:
In the upcoming game, scheduled for October 24, 2026
If Chelsea FC wins, this market will resolve to "Yes".
Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve "No".
This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. Revisions to officially declared final scores made after market resolution will not be accounted for in determining the outcome. If no acceptable data is available within 24 hours of the event's conclusion, this market will resolve 50-50, or to "Draw" where applicable.

I couldn't fetch the official resolution result, and nothing before the 17 October cutoff settles the question. The match is Chelsea vs Tottenham at Stamford Bridge on 24 October. Every page fetch was refused by the proxy, so everything below comes from search-result summaries. Anything dated after 17 October has been left out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding result is Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 24 October 2026, Chelsea's eighth league game. Sources list kickoff as 15:00 (footballtransfers) or 17:30 BST (Vavel). [theScore](https://www.thescore.com/epl/event/98341), [Vavel](https://www.vavel.com/en/data/chelsea-fc/fixtures/), [FootballTransfers](https://www.footballtransfers.com/en/teams/uk/chelsea/fixtures-results)
- The governing body's official result (premierleague.com) decides it, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. No result was available as of the cutoff.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing before 17 October settles the question. The match had not been played.

## 3. Recent news (newest first, up to the cutoff)
- 2026-10-11: Alonso praised Caicedo, who made his first start of the season after a calf problem. Reuters said Chelsea had now gone 23 straight Premier League games without a clean sheet. [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/football/2026/10/11/soccer-alonso-hails-caicedos-impact-as-chelsea-crush-bournemouth)
- 2026-10-10: Chelsea beat Bournemouth 5-1 at home. Henderson scored twice and João Pedro also scored. Chelsea moved to 5th (one source says 4th, on 10 points). [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/chelsea-vs-bmouth/report/559496), [Africa Soccer](https://africasoccer.com/?p=634246)
- 2026-09-18: Brentford beat Chelsea 3-0, Chelsea's third league game in a row without a win. Chelsea had conceded at least twice in all five league games under Alonso, and João Pedro had a knee injury at the time. [Radio X](https://www.radiox.co.uk/news/sport/brentford-3-0-chelsea-defensive-issues-for-xa/), [NST](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/sports/football/2026/09/1535830/brentford-batter-chelsea-undo-alonsos-promising-start)
- Context: Xabi Alonso is Chelsea's new manager after a 10th-place finish last season, and Chelsea are not in the Champions League. Tottenham, under Roberto De Zerbi, went into mid-October without a league win this season and at or near the bottom of the table. [Hayters](https://hayters.com/chelsea-fixture-list-in-full-with-derby-first-up-for-new-boss-xabi-alonso/), [Sky Sports](https://skysports.com/football/news/11095/13555669/chelsea-premier-league-2026-27-fixtures-and-schedule)
- Team news: one preview reports Chelsea's first-choice goalkeeper has a broken jaw, so Penders would start in goal, and that Reece James, Malo Gusto and Chavarria are out. The preview's publication date is unclear and may be after the cutoff. [Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/chelsea-vs-tottenham-prediction-pick-050944074.html)

## 4. Base rates
- Football365 says Chelsea are on a six-game Premier League winning streak against Tottenham. [Football365](https://www.football365.com/match-preview/chelsea-v-tottenham-prediction-preview-2026-27)
- Home favourites priced around 4/6 (about 58-60% implied) win roughly 55-60% of the time over 90 minutes.
- Chelsea's league form this season is mixed: roughly 3 wins in 7, and a leaky defence.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Football365: Chelsea 4/6, draw 3/1, Spurs 16/5. Racing Post / Paddy Power: Chelsea 4/6, draw 3/1, Spurs 7/2. Both are about 58-60% implied for a Chelsea win. These previews may be dated after 17 October. [Racing Post](https://www.racingpost.com/sport/football-tips/premier-league/chelsea-vs-tottenham-odds-predictions-betting-tips-team-news-bet-builder-aTecz3s7Ywvo/)
- Oddschecker cites Polymarket at +100 for a Chelsea win (about 50%). [Oddschecker](https://www.oddschecker.com/us/picks-parlays/soccer/cng201-20261024-chelsea-vs-tottenham-lineups-prediction-betting-picks-odds)
- Pundit picks: Sports Mole 3-1 Chelsea; TNT Sports and Oddschecker 2-1 Chelsea. [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/chelsea/preview/chelsea-vs-spurs-prediction-team-news-lineups_607411.html), [TNT Sports](https://www.tntsports.co.uk/betting/tips/chelsea-vs-tottenham-hotspur-prediction-tips-and-odds-premier-league-24-10-26/)
- I could not find Kalshi or Manifold prices from before the cutoff.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The weekend of 17-18 October is a Premier League matchday for Chelsea; I could not confirm the opponent. Tottenham play Coventry at home on Monday 19 October.
- Chelsea's next game after Spurs is a Carabao Cup tie at Liverpool on 28 October, which could affect rotation. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/fixtures/_/id/363/chelsea)
- Watch for team news on the goalkeeper and full-backs and João Pedro's fitness, and for the final lineups about an hour before kickoff.
